note: What the admin screens would save for this category. Weights, scales and checks are data, not code.

project.description: 150 kW rooftop solar system on a warehouse in Windsor, Ontario. Budget ceiling $260,000 CAD. Must be complete within 16 weeks of award.

fields.question: Does the proposal state that the bidding company itself holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence (ECRA/ESA)? Answer false if the licence belongs to a subcontractor or partner, or is promised later.
The bidder's ECRA/ESA licence number, exactly as written.
Does the proposal confirm the bidder has current WSIB clearance?
The bidder's liability insurance coverage amount in CAD (for example $5M = 5000000).

How many completed commercial solar installations of 100 kW or larger does the bidder claim in the last 5 years? If the stated period reaches back further than 5 years (before 2021), still report the stated count but set status to unclear.
The time period the bidder gives for those installations, as written.
The total price for the project in CAD.
The committed completion time in weeks from award. Use null with status unclear if the schedule is not committed to a number.
Does the proposal commit a named project lead or project manager now? Answer false if a lead or coordinator will only be assigned later.
Number of crew members committed to the project.
Does the proposal include a site safety plan?
Does the proposal include ongoing performance monitoring of the installed system? Construction progress reports do not count.
